_translators: Copy for the home page (nidaaprayer.app). Values may hold   to keep two words together. Keep the product names as they are: Nidaa, iPhone, Apple Watch, App Store, Google Play, Siri, VoiceOver, Waze, Apple Maps, Google Maps, PDF. Use the app's own words for its features. No em dashes. Header and footer words come from content/privacy/<lang>.json.
title: Nidaa · Prayer times, adhan and Qibla for iPhone and Apple Watch
description: Prayer times, the adhan and the Qibla on iPhone and Apple Watch. Prayer times are calculated on your phone, so they work offline. No account, no ads, no analytics.

hero.title: Make room for prayer
hero.lede: Prayer times, the adhan and the Qibla on iPhone and Apple Watch. Prayer times are calculated on your phone, so they work offline.

items.title: Prayer times offline
items.text: Prayer times and the Qibla are calculated on your phone. Once your location is saved, no signal is needed.

items.title: The times your mosque keeps
items.text: The calculation method for your country, Shafi or Hanafi Asr, and minute adjustments for each prayer.

items.title: The month on one page
items.text: A monthly timetable you can share or print as a one page PDF.

items.title: Sunnah days
items.text: Reminders for Jumu’ah, the White Days, Mondays and Thursdays, Arafah, Ashura and the last third of the night.

items.title: Widgets
items.text: Today’s prayers and the next one on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

items.title: Siri and Shortcuts
items.text: Ask Siri when the next prayer is, or build it into a shortcut.

items.title: The Hijri date
items.text: Beside today’s date, and adjustable by a day or two to match your moon sighting.

items.title: In your language
items.text: 13 languages, larger text, VoiceOver, and light and dark appearance.

quiet.title: Nidaa knows nothing about you
quiet.text: No account, no ads, no analytics. Nidaa collects nothing.
